name: Right Angle
invitation: Two banks meet at a right angle, off to the right of the clearing. The first shot runs straight past them. The banks stay put. Aim and power are yours.
physicalQuestion: What does a shot into that right angle do, and how does a small aim step move the landing?
nearbySensitivity: At the recorded return, yaw 38.5°, elevation 14.5°, and charge 0.86, one slider step still strikes both banks and lands back toward the carriage. Yaw 38.0° lands about 4.1 m from the origin and yaw 39.0° about 9.0 m. Elevation 14.0° and 15.0° land about 9.6 m and 5.9 m out. Charge 0.85 and 0.87 land about 7.0 m and 10.2 m out. Opening yaw 0.5° and yaw -0.5°, at elevation 18° and charge 0.55, still miss both banks and land near 46.1 m.
validationEvidence: Headless Havok at 120 Hz, seed 20261109, through scripts/range/run.mjs and scripts/foundry/discovery-*.mjs. The corner map fired 42525 player-step shots. The neighbour grid fired 21750. The validator replays the opening miss and one two-face return. Enjoyment and a physical phone were not tested.

limitations.concept: A right angle that can send a shot back toward the carriage
limitations.missing: Banks have no height offset, so the corner cannot be lifted or given a lip over a pocket.
limitations.extension: One height offset on the existing bank, keeping its friction and restitution. No new contact law. Not built.

limitations.concept: A landing that only the two-face path can reach
limitations.missing: Open ground in front of the corner can also be reached by a short arc that never touches a bank.
limitations.extension: Do not add a circle in that open ground. A later lip would be the same height offset, not a new goal kind. Not built.

limitations.concept: The corner reads as the subject, including on a phone
limitations.missing: Survey is a free orbit and does not label the corner.
limitations.extension: A one-line caption under Survey, with no new geometry. Not built.

limitations.concept: The family of aims was measured outside the replay
limitations.missing: The validator replays recorded shots. It does not search neighbouring aims on its own.
limitations.extension: Leave the replay as it is. The neighbour grid stays a lane script.
